name: Incline Sit-Up
instructions: Set a bench so the head end is raised, lie back on it with your knees bent and feet planted or hooked under the foot pad, and place your hands behind your head.
Curl your torso up off the bench by flexing your spine, then continue until your chest moves toward your thighs.
Lower back down under control until your back rests on the bench again.
This is easier than a flat sit-up because the raised head end shortens the range of motion. Do not pull on your neck with your hands.
image_prompt_scene: Lying back on an incline bench with the head end raised, torso resting on the pad, hands behind the head and feet planted.
